category_title: Gifted Hispanic female underachieving due to perceived inadequacy and lack of task relevance
scenario_title: Writing assignment feedback and lack of revision effort
minimal_context: The tutor and student are reviewing written comments on an English essay during a one-on-one meeting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your essay, Jennifer. Please look over the written comments I left on it so you can revise it for the final draft.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Wait, you actually read my paper? I just figured you would put a grade on it and hand it back.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, I read all the papers. What do you think about the feedback I wrote?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I mean, I got a 95 on it. I'm satisfied with my work as long as my grades are acceptable.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: But you could elaborate more and extend your thinking. Don't you want to improve?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't see any advantage in making the additional effort to read and apply those comments. I already have a good grade, and I don't see any value in how this task is relevant to my life anyway.

TUTOR: Here is your essay, Jennifer. Please look over the written comments I left on it so you can revise it for the final draft.

TUTOR: But you could elaborate more and extend your thinking. Don't you want to improve?

STUDENT: I don't see any advantage in making the additional effort to read and apply those comments. I already have a good grade, and I don't see any value in how this task is relevant to my life anyway.

task.content: Writing essays for English class; evaluating the effort required versus the perceived value/relevance of the task.
task.learning_goal: growth and improvement in literacy skills

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Responding to teacher feedback on writing assignments during English class.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: she was not showing growth or any indication that she was reading and applying my comments for her growth and improvement in literacy skills.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: she was satisfied with her work as long as her grades were acceptable... saw no reason to elaborate or extend her thinking because she saw no advantage in making the additional effort... saw no value in how the task was relevant to her life.

behavior_patterns.condition: Verbal interactions and participation during English class curriculum
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: she simply did not exhibit the usual exuberance for curriculum or display a high level of impassioned participation
